verdict.rationale: The evidence indicates telemetry is effectively avoided by design in local mode. A reply on the HN thread states "Fully local - no data is collected," the CLI runs offline and without an account, the Kotlin SDK keeps working with no network, and the SDK repo claims "Private by default." However, nothing documents an actual telemetry policy or an opt-out control, and the no-collection claim comes only from a community thread rather than first-party docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of SDK/CLI telemetry behavior, an explicit opt-out setting or flag, clarity on usage tracking for hosted (Cloud) use, and independent verification that no data is collected.
